items.name: Amjad Masad
items.text: With two separate Riemann proofs, one AI and one Human, coming out at the same time, assuming they’re both correct, it’ll be interesting to see the difference especially on elegance. https://t.co/rp4thKnxg7
items.textZh: 同一时间出现了两份彼此独立的黎曼猜想证明，一份由 AI 完成，一份由人类完成。假设两份都正确，比较它们在表达优雅性上的差异会很有意思。

items.name: Garry Tan
items.text:
You don’t need an asset seizure tax

You need to encourage building new ideas and startups in California

And then you need a government that spends it wisely on things that help the people

That’s it. The ivory tower academics and the SEIU-HNW union bosses have it wrong. https://t.co/mQ2pO8EMLG
items.textZh: 你不需要资产征收税。你需要鼓励人们在加州创造新想法、创办新公司，同时需要一个能把税收明智地花在公共利益上的政府。就这么简单。那些象牙塔里的学者和工会高层的观点是错的。

items.name: Guillermo Rauch
items.text:
ISO 42001:2023 is like the "SOC2 of AI".

It’s the first global, independently audited standard for how companies build, evaluate, monitor and govern AI systems.

When you ship on and use Vercel’s AI, you now know the infra is audited annually by an accredited third party. https://t.co/8vT5AYUjNd
items.textZh: ISO 42001:2023 可以看作 AI 领域的“SOC 2”。它是首个针对企业如何构建、评估、监控和治理 AI 系统的全球性独立审计标准。使用 Vercel AI 的人可以知道，其基础设施每年都会接受经认可的第三方审计。

items.name: Thariq
items.text:
I think I’ve figured out the gameplay loop!

It’s a sports anime game, but the sport is elemental bending.

You fight in tournaments alongside your squad, and between matches they have their own stories you can get into, like in Mass Effect or Dragon Age. https://t.co/Z21CYJxYoX https://t.co/hLIVplRPrW
items.textZh: 我想明白游戏的核心循环了！这是一款体育番风格的游戏，但运动项目是元素操控。你和队友一起参加锦标赛，比赛之间还能像《质量效应》或《龙腾世纪》那样深入了解角色自己的故事。

items.name: Aaron Levie
items.text: This year we’ve had a clear jump in model capability where instead of telling agents precisely what to do, it’s better to use these systems to solve problems you can’t easily define yourself. A year ago you’d need to very clearly tell agents the how to design and develop your product idea, or there was almost no chance of success. Now, increasingly, the agent likely can come up with a better implementation than you’d have thought of because you can have it connect the dots between a far greater solution space than you can. This will be increasingly true in basically every domain of kneeler work. We’re going to see this impact in finance, legal, life sciences, cyber, and many other spaces where no person can hold onto all the available relevant industry knowledge to think of the best solution. Ultimately this is going to reshape our relationship with AI and how we deploy agents in our work. It won’t be about explicitly telling them, but instead giving them goals and enough freedom to pursue them in the best way they can.
items.textZh: 今年模型能力出现了明显跃迁：与其精确指挥 Agent 每一步怎么做，不如让它们解决那些本身难以定义的问题。一年前，你必须非常清楚地告诉 Agent 如何设计和开发产品，否则几乎不可能成功。现在，Agent 越来越能在更大的方案空间里自主关联信息，甚至提出比你原先设想更好的实现方式。未来这会影响金融、法律、生命科学、网络安全等几乎所有需要综合大量行业知识的领域。AI 与 Agent 的使用方式也会随之改变：重点不再是逐步指挥，而是给出目标和足够的自主空间。
